name: space-at-scale
description: Space-at-Scale: an inline 3D simulation at three scales you can open, play and query in Claude. Solar system in AU, Local Bubble in light years, Milky Way in thousands of light years, each running forward and backward in time. Use /space-at-scale to open it.
